records.issue_text: deleteCache.handler.ts:22 throws plain Error instead of TRPCError with proper codes, surfacing as opaque INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
records.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts`, the handler does `throw new Error("Credential not found or access denied")` when the credential lookup fails. Since this is invoked via a tRPC `mutation` (`calendarsRouter.deleteCache`), throwing a plain `Error` will typically be mapped to an `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` response, rather than a proper typed `TRPCError` (e.g., `NOT_FOUND`/`FORBIDDEN`). This is incorrect behavior for an access-denied/not-found condition and can surface as an opaque 500 to clients.
records.stripped_text: deleteCache.handler.ts:22 throws plain Error instead of TRPCError with proper codes, surfacing as opaque INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
